summary: Confirmed a source-copy mismatch. The initial contact page says users can ‘send us a message’ and offers Submit without upfront preview-only disclosure. One synthetic volatile submit returned ok:true, remote:false, ‘Nothing was sent’; fixture realMail:false, no contact/mail port, provider receipt delta 0, snapshot unchanged. Existing controller test expects local-simulation/no remote effects; public-site test checks fields/counter only. Suggested repair: disclose before the form that submission is preview-only and sends nothing; include a direct contact method only if verified.
